text: Samala (also called "Ineseño" or "Ynezeño") is a member of the Chumashan language family; the others are Barbareño, Interior Chumash, Cruzeño, Obispeño, Purisimeño, and Ventureño.

title: Providing percussion - toacorn.com
text: SHARING CULTURE-The Chumash Intertribal Singers share music and culture at the Satwiwa Native American Cultural Center in Newbury Park last Saturday. The vocalists sing music using different Chumash languages; Obispeño, Cruzeño, Barbareño, Ineseño, Purisimeño and Ventureño. They accompany themselves with hand-held percussion.

title: Santa Ynez Band of Chumash Mission Indians - Wikiwand
text: The Santa Ynez Band of Chumash Mission Indians is a federally recognized tribe of Chumash, an Indigenous people of California, in Santa Barbara. [2] Their name for themselves is Samala. [3] The locality of Santa Ynez is referred to as 'alaxulapu in Chumashan language. [4][5]
